Hi The Metaverse,

Thank you so much for the 5-star review!  We truly appreciate you taking the time to share your experience with us. It means so much to our team to know that you and your furry family member had a great visit. We look forward to seeing you both again soon! 

Liz, Owner

I emailed and left message for Liz to call and discuss the before and after pics below. It’s been 2 weeks and not a peep. I’ve been patronizing Puff and Fluff since its grand opening years ago. Sometimes extremely satisfied and sometimes not as much, but I let it go because not every experience is gonna be perfect and I really like Kimberly. She works hard. But this is unacceptable, obviously a breakdown in communication. My dog doesn’t even look like an Bichon anymore. You never in no circumstances shave a bichon’s tail. It’s their trademark. The groomer claimed he was matted. His fur was as usual very thick and hard to work with because he’s got so much hair as some bichons are thicker than others. Which means Toby had an outstanding breeder.  I get that Toby is a lot of work because of his thick fur but this is unbelievable and unacceptable. I bathe him and condition his fur every Tuesday followed by brushing. This pictured grooming is a result of laziness and not wanting to put in the work. I was told over 2 weeks ago that I would get a refund and Liz would call me but nothing but no refund and no word from Liz. BTW it will take up to a year for his tail to grow back. I’m devastated and so disappointed as Toby was photographed often for dog businesses in the area.

The staff was nice enough and seemingly good with my puppy-but she left with an uneven groom (one ear longer than the other, one paw longer, etc) and they cut her face to look very poodle like despite my asking multiple times if they were …

Thank you for taking the time to give us a 5 Star Review. We greatly appreciate it. We look forward to seeing you again soon. 
Liz, Owner
My dog had a severe traumatic experience here. I don’t know what happened but he is 3.5 yo, has never had issues, been groomed all his life, but he was terrified when I picked him up. …
My pup loves her weekly visit to Puff & Fluff! They love her and take great care of her.

Been going here for years, usually good. Today, terrible! shaved my dog completely, then tried to say that’s how the dog is always groomed. Showed no remorse and still charged full price for a shave not a groom. Completely unprofessional
Great experience for our berry active goldendoodle. The cut was outstanding!! They did exactly what I asked for.
I've been taking my standard poodle here for over a year now and they always do a great job.
